headline: Finish Him?
caption:
Alexander Volkanovski says he'll finish unbeaten Movsar Evloev in 'pretty wild fashion' at UFC 333.
Volk or Evloev? 👇

Evloev (20-0) has won all 10 of his UFC fights on the scorecards and says real fans appreciate skill and wrestling. The featherweight title fight headlines UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi this Saturday, Oct 24.

Who keeps the belt?
question: Volk or Evloev?

v2.story: Volk predicts a wild finish. Evloev, 0 finishes in 10 UFC wins, says decisions still win titles.
